cohort: The study included 10 women who delivered at term by scheduled skin-to-skin cesarean birth at an urban tertiary care hospital in Toronto, Ontario, and had a previous planned or unplanned cesarean birth.
finding: Women reported feeling supported, experiencing greater control, and fostering a stronger connection with their infant during skin-to-skin cesarean births, while also recognizing logistical considerations.
mod_finding: Women experienced greater control, enhanced bonding and intimacy, facilitated breastfeeding, and bolstered confidence during early parenthood with skin-to-skin cesarean births compared to standard cesarean births.
